errors.evidence: The value for the blue line ('städtische Räume') in 2019 is approximately 3.4%, not 3.3%. The value from 2018 to 2019 is also not constant, it increases from ~3.3% to ~3.4%.
The value for the black line ('Differenz') in 2016 is approximately 0.8%, not 0.7%.
The value for the black line ('Differenz') in 2019 is exactly on the 1.0% grid line, not 1.1%.

The value for the black line ('Differenz') in 2022 is closer to 0.8% than 0.9%. The difference between the green line (~4.9%) and the blue line (4.0%) is 0.9%, so the black line should be at 0.9. However, the data point for the black line in 2022 is visually plotted lower, at approximately 0.8%.
